fr_html: Le PRESIDENT fait observer que, si les conditions ont changé, le changement est de nature à inviter à plus de prudence encore qu'en 1907.
en_html: The PRESIDENT observed that if conditions had changed, the change was of such kind as to necessitate still more caution than in 1907.
